verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a shared serverless tier with pay-per-token access to 'the most popular OSS models' and 'the latest open models' via api.fireworks.ai, with no GPUs to size. It also lists 100+ supported models across text, vision, audio, image and embeddings, plus a recommended-models guide for open-weight choices. Its docs note that on-demand deployments offer a wider selection than serverless, so the serverless catalog is a subset. missing for 10: no evidence naming which families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) are actually on serverless endpoints, no serverless model list showing breadth or currency, no independent corroboration of the serverless catalog.
